images.caption: Figure 1:Overview of CurvDelta.(a)Unconstrained optimization reaches low task loss but high preservation loss.(b)CurvDelta constructs a low-curvature delta space. The applied delta remains in this space throughout optimization, reaching a different solution with comparable task loss.(c)The base weights and projections remain frozen. The trainable delta is a dense matrix in CurvDelta or LoRA in CurvLoRA.(d)Performance comparison. The dashed line marks the base model’s retention average. Our methods achieve the best trade-off between task performance and capability retention.
